symbols.name: R_P
symbols.def: \(R_P(Q)=\sum_xp_x\sum_{i,j}d_{xij}^2/[e_x(1-e_x)s_{xij}]\), with the closed perspective value zero at \(s_{xij}=d_{xij}=0\)

symbols.name: C_x
symbols.def: \(C_x(t_x)\) is the conditional version of \(C_P\) in stratum \(x\)

symbols.name: f_N
symbols.def: \(f_N(r)=r^{-1}-1\) for \(r>0\), with the closed convex extension at zero
symbols.role: Neyman generator in the published \(f\)-divergence orientation

symbols.name: w_Q
symbols.role: observed-data weight induced by a compatible full law

symbols.name: \mathcal W^{\mathrm{IHK}}_{\Gamma}(P)
symbols.role: one-stratum Jensen--CMC and box-relaxed weight set

symbols.name: P'
symbols.role: generic observed law in the profile region

symbols.name: P''
symbols.role: second generic observed law in the regular region

symbols.name: P_\vartheta
symbols.role: observed law indexed by a multinomial cell vector

symbols.name: \Theta_{\mathrm{reg}}(\delta)
symbols.role: uniformly Slater-regular multinomial region on \(\mathcal T_0\)

symbols.name: L_{\mathrm{reg}}(\delta)
symbols.role: dual-certified frontier Lipschitz modulus on the regular region

symbols.name: \theta_0
symbols.def: \(\theta_0\) is the one-stratum law with \(e_x=1/2\), \(p_1=4/5\), and \(p_0=1/5\)

symbols.name: \mathcal C_n
symbols.role: generic confidence set for the null cost

symbols.name: \mathfrak T_P
symbols.sig: directions in the multinomial tangent cone to \(\ell^\infty(\mathcal T_0)\)

assumptions.condition: The law induced by \(Q\) for \(O\) equals \(P\).

standard.name: observational compatibility of a latent response-type law

assumptions.condition: For every positive-mass response-type cell, \(\ell_x\leq q_{xij}\leq u_x\).
The observations \(O_1,\ldots,O_n\) are independent draws from \(P\).
Every coordinate of the true multinomial vector satisfies \(\theta_{xzy}\geq\delta\).

standard.name: uniform finite-alphabet version of the positive observed-density condition

assumptions.condition: For every \(t\in\mathcal T_0\), the perspective SOCP has a feasible array satisfying each nonredundant response-mass and odds-face inequality with slack at least \(\delta\).

standard.name: uniform Slater margin for a parametric second-order conic program

definitions.name: Full-propensity compatibility class
definitions.construction: \(\mathcal H_\Gamma(P)=\{Q: Q\text{ satisfies observational compatibility, consistency, and }\ell_x\leq q_{xij}\leq u_x\text{ on every positive cell}\}\).

definitions.name: Sharp ATE cost frontier
definitions.construction: \(C_P(t)=\min\{R_P(Q):Q\in\mathcal H_\Gamma(P),\ T(Q)=t\}\) when the fiber is nonempty and \(C_P(t)=+\infty\) otherwise.

definitions.name: Perspective SOCP
definitions.construction: Introduce \(v_{xij}\geq0\) and impose \(\|(2d_{xij}/\sqrt{e_x(1-e_x)},s_{xij}-v_{xij})\|_2\leq s_{xij}+v_{xij}\); minimize \(\sum_xp_x\sum_{i,j}v_{xij}\) subject to the observed-margin, odds-face, and \(T(Q)=t\) equalities and inequalities.

definitions.name: Cellwise conic dual
definitions.construction: Maximize \(\lambda t+\sum_xp_x[e_x\sum_j\alpha_{xj}\pi_{1x,j}+(1-e_x)\sum_i\beta_{xi}\pi_{0x,i}]\) over \(\lambda,\alpha,\beta\) subject to \(\min_{q\in[\ell_x,u_x]}\{(q-e_x)^2/[e_x(1-e_x)]-q\alpha_{xj}-(1-q)\beta_{xi}-\lambda(j-i)\}\geq0\) for all \(x,i,j\).

definitions.name: Discordant-type garbling
definitions.construction: For \(\tau\geq0\), select response-type \(01\) mass equal to \(s_{10}\) independently of \(Z\), send type \(10\) to \(00\) and \(11\) with probabilities \(1-q_{01}\) and \(q_{01}\), and send the selected type \(01\) to \(00\) and \(11\) with probabilities \(q_{10}\) and \(1-q_{10}\); use outcome complementation for \(\tau<0\).

definitions.name: Binary scalar frontier program
definitions.construction: For \(0<\tau<1\), use \(C_P(\tau)=\min_{v\in[L_\tau,U_\tau]}F_\tau(v)\), with feasibility exactly \(L_\tau\leq U_\tau\); negative effects follow by replacing \((p_1,p_0,\tau)\) with \((1-p_1,1-p_0,-\tau)\).

definitions.name: Ishikawa--He--Kanamori Neyman-divergence Jensen--CMC program
definitions.construction: In one stratum let \(f_N(r)=r^{-1}-1\). Specialize Ishikawa--He--Kanamori's equation (14) to the Neyman generator plus the convex interval indicator representing their box model: \(\mathcal W^{\mathrm{IHK}}_{\Gamma}(P)\) contains the nonnegative \(w\) satisfying \(e_xE_P[w(Y,1)\mid Z=1]=1\), \((1-e_x)E_P[w(Y,0)\mid Z=0]=1\), \(e_xw(y,1)\in[e_x/u_x,e_x/\ell_x]\), and \((1-e_x)w(y,0)\in[(1-e_x)/(1-\ell_x),(1-e_x)/(1-u_x)]\). Set \(\mathscr R_{\mathrm{IHK},P}(w)=E_P[Zf_N(e_xw(Y,1))+(1-Z)f_N((1-e_x)w(Y,0))]\) and \(\widetilde C^{\mathrm{IHK}}_P(\tau)=\inf\{\mathscr R_{\mathrm{IHK},P}(w):w\in\mathcal W^{\mathrm{IHK}}_{\Gamma}(P),\ E_P[Zw(Y,1)Y-(1-Z)w(Y,0)Y]=\tau\}\).

definitions.name: Regular interior multinomial region
definitions.construction: \(\Theta_{\mathrm{reg}}(\delta)=\{\vartheta: \vartheta_{xzy}\geq\delta\text{ for every }x\in\mathcal X,z\in\mathcal Z,y\in\mathcal Y,\text{ and for every }t\in\mathcal T_0\text{ the associated perspective SOCP has a feasible array with every nonredundant response-mass and odds-face inequality slack by at least }\delta\}\).

definitions.name: Regular multinomial profile band
definitions.construction: Set \(\mathcal A_n=\{\vartheta:\vartheta\geq0,\ \sum_{x,z,y}\vartheta_{xzy}=1,\ \|\vartheta-\widehat\theta\|_\infty\leq r_n\}\), \(\mathcal A_n^{\mathrm{reg}}=\mathcal A_n\cap\Theta_{\mathrm{reg}}(\delta)\), \(L_{\mathrm{reg}}(\delta)=\sup\{|C_{P'}(t)-C_{P''}(t)|/\|\theta(P')-\theta(P'')\|_\infty:t\in\mathcal T_0,\ \theta(P'),\theta(P'')\in\Theta_{\mathrm{reg}}(\delta),\ P'\neq P''\}\), \(\underline C_n(t)=\inf_{P':\theta(P')\in\mathcal A_n^{\mathrm{reg}}}C_{P'}(t)\), and \(\overline C_n(t)=\sup_{P':\theta(P')\in\mathcal A_n^{\mathrm{reg}}}C_{P'}(t)\).

definitions.name: Perspective tangent-program handle
definitions.construction: Derive \(\mathfrak T_P\) by linearizing the observed-margin and ATE equations on the optimizer set, retaining the positively homogeneous perspective cost on zero cells and the tangent cones of all active odds faces; estimate this operator by active-set enlargement and apply the Fang--Santos derivative bootstrap through \(\widehat{\mathfrak T}_n\).

statements.statement: For every observed law \(P\) satisfying overlap and every \(\Gamma\geq1\), a value \(t\) is generated by some \(Q\in\mathcal H_\Gamma(P)\) with \(R_P(Q)\leq\rho\) if and only if \(C_P(t)\leq\rho\). Every finite value of \(C_P\) is attained, \(D_P\) is a compact interval, every endpoint of \(\mathcal I_P(\rho)\) is attained, \(C_P\) is closed and convex, and the perspective SOCP has \(O(|\mathcal X|K^2)\) cells.
statements.justification: This theorem turns an average confounding budget into an attained sharp identified set for one joint ATE law.
statements.gap: ZhangZhao2026AverageCase proves armwise sharpness but explicitly does not establish simultaneous ATE attainment; DornGuo2023QuantileBalancing establishes joint sharpness only for the worst-case odds model.
statements.consumer: A sensitivity analyst can report the exact ATE interval compatible with one common hidden assignment mechanism at budget \(\rho\).

statements.statement: The program in \(\mathrm{def{:}socp}\) has the value of the explicit cellwise dual in \(\mathrm{def{:}dual}\), and the dual supremum is attained for every \(t\in D_P\), including exposed endpoint fibers and fibers with zero response-type cells.
statements.justification: Endpoint dual attainment supplies analytic certificates and supports comparative statics at odds faces.
statements.gap: Generic Slater arguments do not cover the lower-dimensional endpoint fibers created by zero perspective cells.
statements.consumer: A certified implementation can validate sharp frontier ordinates and endpoint effects without trusting a numerical solver status alone.

statements.statement: For binary outcomes in one stratum, every \(Q\in\mathcal H_\Gamma(P)\) with ATE \(\tau\geq0\) admits the treatment-independent garbling \(G_\tau\) whose image has zero mass on response type \(10\), induces the same \(P\), has the same \(\tau\), remains in \(\mathcal H_\Gamma(P)\), and weakly lowers \(\sum_{i,j}s_{ij}\varphi(q_{ij})\) for every convex \(\varphi\); for \(\tau\leq0\), the analogous image has zero mass on type \(01\).
statements.justification: The garbling is the structural reduction that converts a cross-world four-type problem into an exact scalar frontier.
statements.gap: Manski1997MTR assumes monotone response, while BalkePearl1997Bounds enumerates response types; neither derives monotone support as a convex-cost-improving transformation.
statements.consumer: The theorem makes binary sensitivity curves analytically auditable and separates an optimizer property from a substantive monotone-response assumption.

statements.statement: For one stratum, binary outcomes, and \(0<\tau<1\), the fiber is feasible if and only if \(L_\tau\leq U_\tau\), and \(C_P(\tau)=\min_{v\in[L_\tau,U_\tau]}F_\tau(v)\). If \(L_\tau<U_\tau\), the optimizer equals \(L_\tau\) when \(H_\tau(L_\tau)\geq0\), equals \(U_\tau\) when \(H_\tau(U_\tau)\leq0\), and otherwise is the unique root of \(H_\tau(v)=0\) in \((L_\tau,U_\tau)\). These cases form the complete six-odds-face catalog plus one interior algebraic phase, with support-degenerate cases interpreted by closed perspectives.
statements.justification: A complete phase rule exposes when odds caps, rather than the average budget, determine the frontier.
statements.gap: The closest average-case papers solve separate armwise weight problems and do not give a joint binary odds-face catalog.
statements.consumer: For categorical-mercury analyses with a binary score, every frontier ordinate can be computed by interval arithmetic and one monotone root solve.

statements.statement: For a feasible one-stratum binary null with nonconstant \(Y\), \(C_P(0)=e_x(1-e_x)(p_1-p_0)^2/[m(1-m)]=\operatorname{Corr}_P(Z,Y)^2\); if the null odds inequalities fail, then \(C_P(0)=+\infty\).
statements.justification: The identity gives a directly interpretable assignment-information price for erasing a binary association.
statements.gap: No inspected sensitivity result identifies the feasible sharp null cost with the observed squared correlation while retaining the odds cap.
statements.consumer: Applied readers can benchmark the null budget on the familiar correlation scale and detect when the null is impossible at every finite budget.

statements.justification: The family supplies a closed-form stress test for the full phase catalog and the infinite-sign-reversal boundary.
statements.gap: Published average-case bounds do not give this joint-response ATE profile or its truncated domain.
statements.consumer: The formula yields exact sensitivity intervals and sign-breakdown budgets without optimization.

statements.statement: For any one-stratum full law \(Q\), define \(w_Q(y,1)=E_Q[q_{x,Y(0),Y(1)}^{-1}\mid Y(1)=y,Z=1]\) and \(w_Q(y,0)=E_Q[(1-q_{x,Y(0),Y(1)})^{-1}\mid Y(0)=y,Z=0]\). With Ishikawa--He--Kanamori's observed-policy-first divergence orientation and generator \(f_N\), \(Q\mapsto w_Q\) embeds every full-law ATE fiber into \(\mathcal W^{\mathrm{IHK}}_{\Gamma}(P)\), preserves its ATE, and satisfies \(\mathscr R_{\mathrm{IHK},P}(w_Q)\leq R_P(Q)\), while the unrelaxed divergence is exactly \(R_P(Q)\). The ATE slice is feasible in their Jensen--CMC program at budget \(\rho\) if and only if \(\widetilde C^{\mathrm{IHK}}_P(\tau)\leq\rho\), so \(\widetilde C^{\mathrm{IHK}}_P(\tau)\leq C_P(\tau)\) under the same odds cap and numerical budget. For \(e_x=1/2\), \(p_1=4/5\), \(p_0=1/5\), \(\Gamma=4\), and \(\tau=3/10\), the relaxed program reduces exactly to \(\min_{m_1-m_0=3/10}J(m_1,m_0)=9/91\), attained at \((m_1,m_0)=(13/20,7/20)\), whereas \(C_P(3/10)=9/70\).
statements.justification: The explicit weight embedding and exact rational separation show, on the published budget scale, the quantitative price of requiring one cross-world-compatible assignment mechanism.
statements.gap: IshikawaHeKanamori2026Convex, equations (10), (12), and (14), defines the unrelaxed \(f\)-divergence model and its Jensen--CMC relaxation but leaves realizability open; it does not identify the Neyman-generator embedding or this strict full-law ATE gap.
statements.consumer: A sensitivity analyst avoids declaring an ATE feasible at budgets between \(9/91\) and \(9/70\) when no compatible joint assignment law exists.

statements.statement: For finite \(\mathcal X\) and binary outcomes, if \(C_x\) denotes the conditional frontier in stratum \(x\), then \(C_P(t)=\min\{\sum_xp_xC_x(t_x):\sum_xp_xt_x=t\}\), and conditional optimizers attaining the minimum glue into one compatible full law.
statements.justification: The infimal convolution converts the multi-stratum problem into exact one-dimensional resource allocation.
statements.gap: Armwise average-case optimization does not establish that conditional ATE allocations glue under a shared joint-response law.
statements.consumer: A prespecified finite NHANES stratification can be analyzed with conditional scalar frontiers and a common dual price.

statements.statement: On \(\Theta_{\mathrm{reg}}(\delta)\), the explicit dual implies \(L_{\mathrm{reg}}(\delta)<\infty\). If the true \(\theta\in\Theta_{\mathrm{reg}}(\delta)\), then under independent sampling, with probability at least \(1-\alpha\), simultaneously for every \(t\in\mathcal T_0\), \(C_P(t)\in[\underline C_n(t),\overline C_n(t)]\) and \(0\leq\overline C_n(t)-\underline C_n(t)\leq2L_{\mathrm{reg}}(\delta)r_n\). The modulus is bounded by a computable uniform \(\ell_1\)-bound on the attained cellwise dual multipliers.
statements.justification: This theorem converts multinomial concentration into an honest finite-sample simultaneous band with \(O(n^{-1/2})\) diameter on a named interior region.
statements.gap: ZhangZhao2026AverageCase gives regular bands for armwise sensitivity curves; it does not control the finite-sample diameter of a jointly compatible ATE cost frontier through a dual Slater modulus.
statements.consumer: The categorical-mercury analysis obtains a finite-width simultaneous frontier band whenever its prespecified cells and ATE range satisfy the reported regularity margins.

statements.statement: Fix \(\Gamma=4\), \(h>0\), and \(0<\alpha<1/2\). At \(\theta_0\), \(C_{P_{\theta_0}}(0)=9/25\), whereas at \(\theta_{n,h}\), \(C_{P_{\theta_{n,h}}}(0)=+\infty\) for every sufficiently large \(n\), and the total variation distance between \(P_{\theta_0}^{\otimes n}\) and \(P_{\theta_{n,h}}^{\otimes n}\) tends to zero. Consequently, any random set \(\mathcal C_n\) satisfying \(P_{\vartheta}^{\otimes n}\{C_{P_{\vartheta}}(0)\in\mathcal C_n\}\geq1-\alpha\) for both \(\vartheta\in\{\theta_0,\theta_{n,h}\}\) obeys \(\liminf_{n\to\infty}P_{\theta_0}^{\otimes n}\{\operatorname{diam}(\mathcal C_n)=+\infty\}\geq1-2\alpha\).
statements.justification: The contiguous two-point argument quantifies why no uniformly honest finite-width interval can cross the finite-to-infinite null-feasibility boundary.
statements.gap: Standard directional-bootstrap theory presumes a finite local parameter; it does not provide this extended-real boundary impossibility result for a sensitivity frontier.
statements.consumer: An analyst is told when an infinite upper endpoint is statistically unavoidable rather than a numerical failure of the profile algorithm.

statements.statement: Can the perspective tangent-program handle weaken uniform Slater regularity to a sharp facial metric-regularity condition while retaining uniform Hadamard directional differentiability of \(P\mapsto(C_P(t))_{t\in\mathcal T_0}\) through zero primal cells, nonunique optimizers, and moving odds faces, and can a uniformly consistent \(\widehat{\mathfrak T}_n\) yield derivative-bootstrap bands that attain the \(n^{-1/2}\) regular-profile diameter? Near the finite-to-infinite boundary, can one construct an adaptive exact multinomial or Poisson--Gaussian hybrid inversion whose extended-real behavior matches the two-point lower bound?
statements.justification: This is the open efficiency and adaptation step beyond the proved regular finite-sample diameter and the boundary impossibility result.
statements.gap: DuanZhangZhang2018SOCP assumes finite value, compact optimizers, and Slater regularity; FangSantos2019Directional and FirpoGalvaoParker2023Value require a stable finite-valued application-specific derivative. None treats this facially degenerate extended-real perspective frontier.
statements.consumer: The result would provide simultaneous uncertainty quantification fine enough to compare scientifically relevant budgets across the full categorical sensitivity curve.

statements.statement: Regression corollary: when \(\Gamma=1\), \(D_P=\{\Delta_P\}\), \(C_P(\Delta_P)=0\), and \(\mathcal I_P(\rho)=\{\Delta_P\}\) for every \(\rho\geq0\).
statements.justification: This regression corollary checks that the frontier collapses to the standard identified ATE when hidden assignment distortion is excluded.
statements.gap: This is a required sanity reduction rather than a novelty claim.
statements.consumer: Software and applied analyses obtain the usual observed-law ATE exactly at the no-confounding benchmark.

sampling_model.design: Independent superpopulation sampling from the finite multinomial observed law \(P\).
sampling_model.units: The observations are \(O_1,\ldots,O_n\), with fixed finite \(\mathcal X\), binary treatment, and \(K\)-category outcomes.
sampling_model.treatment: Treatment is observational; a candidate full law uses \(q_{xij}=Q(Z=1\mid X=x,Y(0)=i,Y(1)=j)\).
sampling_model.overlap: The observed propensity satisfies \(\varepsilon\leq e_x\leq1-\varepsilon\) on positive-mass strata.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: All nuisance quantities are multinomial cell probabilities. Simultaneous cell-frequency concentration and the dual Lipschitz modulus deliver the finite-sample regular-region band; the open local theory uses an estimated directional derivative under weaker facial regularity.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: The average-case sensitivity model leads to sharp bounds for \(E[Y(0)]\) and \(E[Y(1)]\), respectively.
The estimated range converges to the narrowest possible interval that must contain the true treatment effect.
Equations (10), (12), and (14) replace the base-policy \(f\)-divergence constraint by its Jensen lower bound and conditional moment constraints on observed-data weights.
Monotone treatment response is maintained as a substantive restriction on individual response behavior.
The paper derives a Hadamard directional derivative for finite-valued Slater-regular linear SOCP optimal values.
An alternative resampling scheme is proposed which remains consistent when the bootstrap fails.
The paper develops uniform derivative-bootstrap inference for finite-valued function-valued optimization maps.

tldr: A finite observed law is lifted to one joint law of treatment and both potential outcomes, and the least Pearson assignment information needed to support each ATE is profiled. The attained sharp frontier has a perspective SOCP and explicit dual. For binary outcomes, a treatment-independent garbling removes the minority discordant response type without imposing monotone treatment response and without increasing any convex assignment cost; this yields the complete six-face scalar catalog and a squared-correlation null identity. An explicit embedding into the published Ishikawa--He--Kanamori Neyman-divergence Jensen--CMC program proves the same-budget separation \(9/70>9/91\). On a named uniformly Slater-regular multinomial region, profile bands have finite-sample \(O(n^{-1/2})\) diameter, while a contiguous boundary pair proves that honest bands must retain infinite diameter at a finite-to-infinite null-cost boundary.

project_justification.gap: Average-case sensitivity analysis has sharp armwise potential-outcome bounds but no jointly attained ATE frontier. Ishikawa--He--Kanamori's published \(f\)-divergence computation uses Jensen and conditional-moment relaxations whose cross-world realizability is unresolved. Existing inference theory does not quantify both the regular finite-sample width and the finite-to-infinite boundary obstruction for this frontier.
project_justification.niche: Finite outcomes make the missing joint law explicit and expose a response-type garbling geometry that is invisible to armwise reweighting.
project_justification.fill: The project profiles the exact full-law Pearson cost, certifies it by primal and dual conic programs, solves the binary geometry, embeds the full-law model into the published Jensen--CMC program with identical budget normalization, and pairs a finite-sample regular-region diameter theorem with a contiguous boundary lower bound.

related_work: Zhang and Zhao motivate average rather than worst-case assignment distortion and prove sharp bounds for each average potential outcome, but their discussion explicitly withholds joint ATE attainment. Dorn and Guo prove simultaneous ATE sharpness for the worst-case odds model through a two-point extremal construction; their compatible-law logic informs the present proof, while the shared strictly convex budget changes the optimizer. Ishikawa, He, and Kanamori define an observed-policy-first \(f\)-divergence in their equation (10), apply Jensen in equation (12), and combine the relaxed divergence with CMC in equation (14). Theorem 6 uses \(f_N(r)=r^{-1}-1\), proves that their unrelaxed budget equals \(R_P\), maps each compatible full law into their weight set, and gives the strict same-budget ATE-slice separation \(9/70>9/91\). Balke and Pearl supply the finite response-type representation, and Manski supplies the substantive monotone-response benchmark; Theorem 3 differs by deriving monotone support for an extremal law without assuming it of the population. Duan, Zhang, and Zhang derive directional derivatives for finite-valued Slater-regular SOCP values, while Fang and Santos and Firpo, Galvao, and Parker supply derivative-aware statistical inference. Theorems 7 and 8 establish regular finite-sample diameter control and a nonregular boundary lower bound; the weaker facial conditions and adaptive derivative bootstrap remain Open-ended Question 1.
technical_internal_limitation: The interior binary stationarity equation is generically quintic, so the exact catalog isolates a unique algebraic root and does not promise universal radical formulas. The finite regular-profile constant can deteriorate as the observed-cell or Slater margin \(\delta\) approaches zero; Theorem 8 shows that this deterioration reflects a genuine statistical discontinuity at the null-feasibility boundary.
honest_scope: The sharpness, dual attainment, garbling, scalar catalog, explicit published-program embedding, strict relaxation gap, regular-region finite-sample diameter, and boundary impossibility are theorem claims to be proved. Uniform tangent inference under weaker facial regularity and adaptive derivative-bootstrap inversion remain open. The \(\Gamma=1\) specialization is retained only as a regression corollary. The application target is a prespecified categorical mercury score and finite covariate stratification; it does not claim to recover the original continuous-outcome NHANES estimand.

seed_details.anchor_read: The introduction, Proposition 6 and its proof, the paragraph following Proposition 6, and the Discussion were read in the accepted arXiv source. The proof constructs sharp completions one potential outcome at a time; the first changed step is to impose one joint response-type law before optimizing the shared assignment budget.
seed_details.kernel: Characterize the attained full-law cost profile \(C_P(t)\) and prove that the budgeted ATE set is exactly \(\{t:C_P(t)\leq\rho\}\), with an explicit perspective SOCP and strong dual.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for joint full-propensity Pearson ATE frontiers, triangular-discrimination ATE sensitivity, and full-law average-case ATE sharpness found armwise average-case bounds and worst-case joint sharpness, but no shared-budget profile.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from ZhangZhao2026AverageCase by subtracting its two sharp armwise bounds.
seed_details.rebuttal: That paper explicitly states that its continuously varying armwise optimizers need not be simultaneously attainable; the joint law and shared cost are absent.

seed_details.anchor_read: The response-function construction and sharp finite-table argument were read together with the paper's introduction and conclusion. The first changed proof step is to replace enumeration alone by a treatment-independent Markov kernel on response types and then invoke convex perspective contraction.
seed_details.kernel: Show that every feasible binary full law can be garbled to remove the minority discordant response type while preserving observed margins, the ATE, and the odds cap and while lowering every convex assignment-information cost.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches combining response-type garbling, monotone response, marginal sensitivity, Pearson cost, and convex information found monotone response as an assumption, but not a without-loss extremal reduction.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Manski1997MTR because monotone response deletes discordant types.
seed_details.rebuttal: Manski imposes monotone response on the population; the proposed kernel derives monotone support for an optimizer without restricting the true law and certifies convex-cost dominance.

seed_details.anchor_read: Section 2, equations (10), (12), and (14), the realizability discussion, and the conclusion were read in the arXiv source. In the paper's observed-policy-first orientation, \(f_N(r)=r^{-1}-1\) makes the unrelaxed divergence exactly \(R_P\); conditional Jensen yields the observed-weight cost and CMC used in the comparator program.
seed_details.kernel: Embed every compatible full law into the published Neyman-divergence Jensen--CMC weight program at identical budget and odds normalization, then quantify strict inequality by the exact rational certificate \(9/70>9/91\).
seed_details.destination_search: The paper itself labels realizability beyond the box model as open; no paper located supplies equality conditions for the Pearson ATE slice.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from strict convexity of Jensen's inequality.
seed_details.rebuttal: Strict convexity alone neither enforces cross-world compatibility nor identifies when marginal minimizers admit one joint assignment mechanism; the exact equality frontier is additional structure.

seed_details.anchor_read: The introduction, Theorems 3.1--3.3, their derivative-estimation construction, and the conclusion were read. The first changed step is to derive a uniform tangent for an extended-real moving-feasible-set perspective program before derivative-aware resampling can be applied.
seed_details.kernel: Prove finite-sample \(O(n^{-1/2})\) profile diameter on a uniformly Slater-regular multinomial region and a contiguous two-point impossibility bound at the finite-to-infinite null-cost boundary; leave weaker facial directional calculus as the open extension.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for directional derivatives of SOCP value maps with zero perspective cells and extended-real sensitivity profiles found finite-valued value-function theory, but no theorem covering this combination.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from FangSantos2019Directional and FirpoGalvaoParker2023Value by applying the directional delta method.
seed_details.rebuttal: Those results require the application-specific derivative and stability conditions; they do not derive a tangent for support-changing extended-real conic profiles.

seed_details.anchor_read: The piecewise-linear optimizer discussion and Proposition 6 boundary were read. The changed step is to optimize a joint three-type response table, yielding six odds faces and a single scalar stationarity equation.
seed_details.kernel: Derive the complete one-stratum binary frontier, including six odds faces, a unique interior algebraic root, and the null identity \(C_P(0)=\operatorname{Corr}_P(Z,Y)^2\).
seed_details.destination_search: No exact binary odds-face catalog for a shared Pearson assignment budget was located.
seed_details.red_team: A routine Karush--Kuhn--Tucker calculation after discretization.
seed_details.rebuttal: The scalar reduction depends on the new garbling theorem, and the null identity and phase transitions are not visible from the unreduced conic program.

seed_details.anchor_read: The population-ATE weighting framework, variance construction, introduction, and discussion were read from the published article. The first changed step is to define full-law compatibility under the target population measure before inserting survey inclusion weights.
seed_details.kernel: Estimate the full population frontier under stratified multistage unequal-probability sampling and prove replicate-weight simultaneous coverage.
seed_details.destination_search: NHANES sensitivity papers use an i.i.d. approximation, while complex-survey causal weighting papers maintain no hidden treatment confounding.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate by multiplying the sensitivity weights by survey weights.
seed_details.rebuttal: The target law, compatibility equations, assignment budget, and sampling variance all change under informative inclusion, so multiplication does not establish sharpness or coverage.

seed_details.anchor_read: The partial \(R^2\) factorization, observed-covariate benchmarking argument, introduction, and conclusion were read. The first changed step is to replace Hilbert-space projection by a full-propensity compatibility program for a removed categorical covariate.
seed_details.kernel: Characterize the attainable \((\Gamma,\rho)\) region generated by omitting a measured categorical covariate and derive a sampling law for the benchmark boundary.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches found approximate fitted-propensity calibration and regression \(R^2\) benchmarking, but no variation-independent full-law Pearson region.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate by computing empirical maxima and second moments of leave-one-covariate propensity ratios.
seed_details.rebuttal: Those plug-in summaries do not certify attainability by a latent full law and are unstable in sparse categorical cells.

seed_details.anchor_read: The conditional-moment relaxation, nonrealizability example, theoretical section, and conclusion were read. The first changed step is to thicken a rational binary witness into a relatively open region while maintaining strict value separation.
seed_details.kernel: Prove strict full-law versus conditional-moment value separation uniformly on a nondegenerate region of binary observed laws.
seed_details.destination_search: The anchor gives nonrealizable weights, but no robust numerical gap for a fixed ATE and Pearson budget.
seed_details.red_team: A single continuity argument around any known counterexample.
seed_details.rebuttal: Continuity fails at feasibility and support boundaries; a useful result must name a regular region and certify both programs' active regimes.

seed_details.anchor_read: The conditional \(f\)-constraint and dual convex formulation were read. The first changed step is to carry the response-type garbling through a general convex perspective rather than Pearson's quadratic generator.
seed_details.kernel: Characterize the convex generators for which binary monotone-support garbling yields a complete sharp ATE frontier.
seed_details.destination_search: General information-cost monotonicity results concern experiment orders, while causal sensitivity papers do not characterize this response-type kernel.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from the data-processing inequality for every \(f\)-divergence.
seed_details.rebuttal: The transformation acts on latent response labels while preserving two different observed margins and the ATE; data processing alone does not guarantee those compatibility identities.

literature_map.settled: Worst-case odds bounds have jointly sharp ATE endpoints, and average-case propensity-ratio models have sharp armwise means and regular armwise inference.
literature_map.unoccupied_pair: No inspected source minimizes one Pearson assignment cost over a joint law of \((Y(0),Y(1),Z,X)\) at every ATE slice.
literature_map.exemplars_used: The setup and motivation arc follow ZhangZhao2026AverageCase; the compatible-law sharpness construction is adapted from DornGuo2023QuantileBalancing.

literature_map.settled: Binary response types support sharp finite optimization, monotone response is a substantive identifying restriction, and convex perspectives encode average assignment distortion.
literature_map.unoccupied_pair: No inspected source uses a treatment-independent response-type kernel to derive monotone support without assuming monotone treatment response.
literature_map.exemplars_used: The response-type table follows BalkePearl1997Bounds, while the convex perspective contraction follows the formulation in IshikawaHeKanamori2026Convex.

literature_map.settled: Conditional-moment and Jensen programs are valid relaxations, box-only marginal sensitivity has realizable extremizers, and general \(f\)-sensitivity admits tractable robust programs.
literature_map.unoccupied_pair: The explicit full-law-to-weight embedding for \(f_N(r)=r^{-1}-1\) and a rational same-data, same-budget, same-odds-cap ATE gap remain absent.
literature_map.exemplars_used: The divergence orientation, Jensen step, and CMC set are equations (10), (12), and (14) of IshikawaHeKanamori2026Convex; exact response-type certification follows BalkePearl1997Bounds.

literature_map.settled: Derivative-aware bootstrap handles known finite-valued directional maps, and uniform inference is available for regular function-valued optimization maps.
literature_map.unoccupied_pair: No inspected result supplies finite-sample simultaneous diameter control for this joint frontier together with a contiguous lower bound at its finite-to-infinite boundary. Uniform tangent stability after facial reduction remains absent beyond the regular region.
literature_map.exemplars_used: The regular theorem uses multinomial concentration and the explicit dual; the boundary theorem uses a contiguous two-point argument, while the open handle composes FangSantos2019Directional resampling with FirpoGalvaoParker2023Value process calculus.
